picks.title: He made your free video player run smoothly. Now he's doing that for robots.

picks.title: John Jumper to join Anthropic
picks.why_it_matters: The AlphaFold creator moving to Anthropic signals accelerating convergence of AI and life sciences, potentially opening new investment opportunities in AI-native biotech and drug discovery startups.

picks.title: Norway imposes near ban on AI in elementary school
picks.why_it_matters: First major regulatory precedent for AI in education could trigger a wave of similar policies across Europe, creating both compliance burdens and opportunities for startups building age-appropriate or teacher-focused AI tools.
